definition: In this source, a pairmate is the female breeding partner of a male mouse, whose signals can influence the male’s parental behavior toward their pups. The term refers to the male’s paired mate, especially the dam he has co-housed and reproduced with.

reasons: The packet supports that “signals from the pairmate dam” can elicit pup retrieval behavior in male mice, but it does not explicitly define “pairmate” as a “female breeding partner.”
